title: Bot binding v1
description: One durable binding between this installation and one Kiro Crew bot generation, as the work-ledger store keeps it. The source identity is memberId plus memoryStore as Crew writes them into the bot's DM slot key. bindingId is opaque and is the only key another component (the Specter profile, XP) may reference; it is never a Crew id. A replacement bot with the same name has a different memberId and therefore a different binding. presence is unknown until the first successful roster poll.
